fields.System.Title: INT-102 — Receive orders from the ERP
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want customer orders to flow in from the ERP, so that the
warehouse works from the same order book as the rest of the business.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a valid order message, then an order is created and validated as in
  • [OUT-102](../OUT/OUT-102-validate-customer-and-products.md).
  • - Given the same message replayed, then exactly one order exists.
  • - Given an invalid message, then it is rejected with every problem listed and stored in
  • the dead-letter table with its original payload.
  • - Given a cancellation message, then it runs the same cancel path as
  • [OUT-104](../OUT/OUT-104-cancel-order.md), releasing reservations.
  • - Given an amendment for an allocated order, then it is rejected rather than applied
  • silently.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, outbound |
| Tables | order, order_line, dead-letter |
| Risks | Retry causing a duplicate order and double shipment ([doc 09 §3.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration · idempotency |
